name: Dielectric induction test proposed
summary: In 1879 the Berlin Academy offered a prize for an experiment to test whether insulators react electromagnetically, a way to decide between rival theories of electricity.
description: A proposed experiment seeks a relation between dielectric polarization and electromagnetic force, testing assumptions that connect Helmholtz’s electrodynamics to Maxwell’s equations.

impact.note: A prize question from one academy changed nothing by itself and led to one line of experiment, which scores below the reviewed tier 2.

why: Helmholtz's electrodynamics and Maxwell's equations made different assumptions about polarization in insulators, and an experiment could decide between them.
